ANALYTICALLY_DISCHARGED.condition: An explicit constructor-specific polynomial circuit/proof architecture is derivable before scaling.
ANALYTICALLY_DISCHARGED.action: Do not run a scientific scaling campaign. Allow only minimal legality/killer-control or optional engineering regression.

PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_COVERS_TARGET_PHENOMEN.condition: The proposed scientific question is already standard or directly covered by existing synthesis/proof/knowledge-compilation literature.
PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_COVERS_TARGET_PHENOMEN.action: Replace the target with a separator/comparison question or a published hard family.

LOWER_BOUND_MODEL_MISMATCH.condition: The cited lower bound is for a different proof/representation model and no preserving reduction is frozen.
LOWER_BOUND_MODEL_MISMATCH.action: Do not use that lower bound to justify the hostile. Either prove/model the reduction or choose another family.

BASELINE_ALREADY_SOLVES_ROUTINELY.condition: Public synthesis tools/corpora already make the proposed family routine and no V1.1-specific separator remains.
BASELINE_ALREADY_SOLVES_ROUTINELY.action: Use as baseline/regression only; do not spend new hostile budget.

GENUINE_SEPARATOR_SURVIVES.condition: Prior art does not settle the exact proof-model question, no simple polynomial discharge trivializes it, and both PASS and FAIL would distinguish V1.1 from a documented baseline/route.
GENUINE_SEPARATOR_SURVIVES.action: Proceed to source freeze, preregistration, implementation review, and at most one authorized hostile run.
